scope: Actual ephemeral local EVM execution only; no external RPC, private credentials, deployed game mutation, AI or financial service operation.
cases: Explicit enabled constructor, controller, fixed 50bps and six decimals
Mint is untaxed and one 100-NHC transfer delivers99.5, burns0.5, emits matching supply events
Floor rounding, zero and first nonzero 200-micro threshold
Self-transfer requires gross balance and only removes its burn
Only immutable controller may toggle, mint or call explicit burns
Controller toggles off and back on without a mutable rate or recipient
transferFrom consumes gross allowance, including self-transfer; infinite allowance stays infinite
Mined insufficient-balance transferFrom reverts its prior allowance write atomically
Explicit vault burn reduces supply without a second transfer fee
Maximum uint256 preview and actual transfer do not overflow fee multiplication
Backed purses and gross withdrawal, constructor burn=true
250-NHC wallet birth is allowance-backed direct burn, constructor burn=true
Purse birth preserves backing and owner-only toggle forwarding, constructor burn=true
After owner enables burn, ordinary wallet-to-vault transfers are taxed too; initial flag=true
Backed purses and gross withdrawal, constructor burn=false
250-NHC wallet birth is allowance-backed direct burn, constructor burn=false
Purse birth preserves backing and owner-only toggle forwarding, constructor burn=false
After owner enables burn, ordinary wallet-to-vault transfers are taxed too; initial flag=false
